lens_summary.drift: REC-C1.6 closure: every step in the user-approved plan lands with green evidence. The latent liveness-marker bug (connected_sessions never populated) was discovered and fixed in-cycle (commit 7afb47ad) — the precondition added in 7197c40e would have been inert without it, as regression-verified by del_live_1 (would have hit SessionNotFound instead of SessionStillActive).

findings.title: delete_session must refuse a still-live probe with a typed error, not silently probe_stop
evidence: crates/chronos-services/src/sessions.rs::delete_session precondition checked BEFORE store.delete_session and delete_durable_execution_log

Two unit tests in sessions::tests: delete_session_refuses_live_session_unit (DEL-LIVE-3 form — typed error, store row survives, hint names session_stop) and delete_session_after_unconnected_succeeds (sanity)
Regression-verified: commenting out the precondition makes delete_session_refuses_live_session_unit fail with 'expected SessionStillActive refusal, got Ok(DeleteResult{..})'

findings.title: SessionsContext::connected_sessions was never populated (latent bug surfaced by the precondition)
evidence: Pre-cycle: grep -nE 'connected_sessions\.insert' crates/chronos-mcp/src/server.rs returned zero hits; the field existed but no code inserted
Fix in commit 7afb47ad: connected_sessions.insert at session_start{action=spawn|attach} Ok arm; connected_sessions.remove at session_stop (both Stopped and AlreadyStopped arms)
Load action is defensive-removed (no probe is attached; we must not refuse on delete)
lifecycle_delete::del_live_1 regression-verified: the same test would have hit SessionNotFound on the pre-fix code path

findings.title: MCP delete_session handler must map ServiceError::SessionStillActive to a text error that names the recovery action
evidence: crates/chronos-mcp/src/server.rs::delete_session match arm: Err(e @ SessionStillActive {..}) => text_content(e.to_string()) (Display impl names session_stop as recovery)
Same variant added to the giant exhaustive match in list_threads for compile exhaustiveness

findings.title: events_read page must carry retention.retained_from_seq and tail.state on every read
evidence: crates/chronos-services/src/events_log_read.rs: RetentionFacts + TailFacts types with serde derives (snake_case TailStateWire: open/sealed/unclean/unknown)
tail_seq is None iff state == Unknown (no inference, no fabrication)
7 unit tests in rec_c1_6_wire_facts_tests: WIRE-RET-1/2 + WIRE-TAIL-1/2/3 + serde shape
EventsReadOutput::Query gains retention + tail fields (chronos-services/src/output.rs); events_read::query passes page.retention and page.tail through (chronos-services/src/events_read.rs)

findings.title: events_read CursorStale must carry a structured json content item alongside the existing text
evidence: crates/chronos-mcp/src/server.rs::events_read CursorStale arm: text_content + json_content({error: 'cursor_stale', requested_next_seq, retained_from_seq})
chronos-sandbox/tests/wire_retention_facts.rs::wire_cursor_1_stale_envelope_carries_structured_numbers: assert content.len()==2 with the EXACT numbers the agent supplied; isError=true preserved
chronos-sandbox restart_uat R2 still parses the text (back-compat) — 4/4 PASS
